verdict.summary: The added #1121 regression test exercises the real run_sweep terminal-reap path at the load-bearing fresh-read boundary. All three cases keep the lease and empty snapshot fixed while varying only the direct issue response: a freshly confirmed open, non-terminal issue retains its claim, while a true absence and a closed response release it. The assertions check both reap counts and exact released-claim sets, and the helper converts exceptions into mismatching values so a crash cannot masquerade as a valid kill. The accompanying rationale accurately scopes the oldest-first pagination residual and the direct-read safety boundary. No production behavior or trust check is weakened, and no correctness, soundness, security, or test-vacuity defect is evident. With no findings in either round 3 or round 4, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
